column1: # Readable English for Latin -> English (la2x, task C11). Our own table; tab-separated; '#' comments.
#   pron    person code (1sg 2sg 3sg.m 3sg.f 3sg.n 1pl 2pl 3pl) x role (subj obj iobj prep poss refl) -> form
#   article def|indef (English: "a"/"an" is chosen by the next sound)
#   prep    Latin preposition + case (abl acc gen; "agent" = ā/ab with a passive verb) -> English preposition
#   conj    coordinating conjunction; note "second" = second-position word (autem, enim, igitur)
#   sub     subordinating conjunction + mood of its clause (ind subj -) -> English; note gives the relation
#   adv     adverb -> English; note: pre (before the main verb), front (sentence start), end, intens (before an
#   det     determiner / quantifier / demonstrative + number (sg pl) or pron.<number> when it stands alone
#   lex     content word override: latin lemma key + part of speech (noun verb adj adv) -> English; note tags:
#           person (a person: who, Spanish "a"), mass (no article), unique (the sun), time:<prep> (bare ablative of
#   phrase  several Latin words (keys, space separated) -> English chunk
#   name    Latin name key -> English spelling
# ---- content words (the lexicon's first gloss is not the plain beginner word) ----
